runtime_encoding: lossless 64-bit line-aligned callback address plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit
decision: count argmax, target top-count, and fill argmax
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP request count, target set, and source fill class

lstm.architecture: single-layer stateful LSTM with independent count, target-ranking, and fill heads
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; hidden/cell values cross chunks and the graph is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology
